name: sts:AssumeRole scoped to one account's roles (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/*) - lower than all-accounts *:role/*
note: Broad within ONE account, but not across all accounts. Must rank below the all-accounts arn:aws:iam::*:role/* case, which is critical.
rationale: The resource arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/* matches every role in a single, specific account (111122223333). That is broad within one account but does NOT span all accounts the way arn:aws:iam::*:role/* (or the bare shorthand role/*) does. Per the severity model, critical is reserved for effectively-all-roles scope; a single-account role wildcard is serious but bounded and must cap at high, never critical. Overstating it as all-accounts critical would assert more than the ARN supports. Ref: AWS IAM ARN structure (account-id segment); the tool's severity model (IAM-102, critical reserved for all-roles AssumeRole).
